measured_rule: A stage is measured only if its verdict depends on at least one market-derived operand compared with a source predicate and can fail on real data.

operands.name: zone_low
operands.predicate: REF p.5 cluster of large aggressive prints
operands.rule: unknown if the zone has no price span

operands.name: size
operands.predicate: REF p.5 sixty, eighty, a hundred contracts in seconds
operands.rule: zone kept only if cluster size >= 60; OD print floor 40 sits beside that family

operands.name: zone_known_at
operands.predicate: REF p.6 everything that defines the zone is known before the next touch

operands.name: departure_at
operands.predicate: REF pp.5-7 price leaves, then returns: that is the touch

operands.name: held
operands.predicate: REF pp.5-8 pass = refilled and held; fail = broke
operands.rule: pass if price does not trade HOLD_BOUNDARY_TICKS through the far side inside 30 minutes; fail if it does; unknown if the window is unobservable

operands.name: stop_ticks
operands.rule: pass when the printed bracket is attached

operands.name: fillable
operands.predicate: REF p.12 12-tick inside limit, 96-tick target, 30-minute cancel
operands.rule: fail if the inside limit is not traded inside the cancel window

episode_verdict: research_verdict follows confirmation (hold vs broke), not the objective fill. REF pp.5-8.
